epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

basemessageuri.description: Reference to a base definition for this definition. Relative references are XIDs within the same registry. Absolute URIs reference message definitions in external registries. The base definition is overridden by this definition. If not present, this definition does not override any base definition

dataschemaformat.description: The schema format applicable to the message payload, equivalent to the 'format' attribute of the schema registry

dataschema.description: The inline schema for the message payload, equivalent to the 'schema' attribute of the schema registry

dataschemauri.description: The URI of the schema for the message payload, equivalent to the 'schemauri' attribute of the schema registry

dataschemaxid.description: Contains the xid of the xRegistry schema Resource entity associated with the dataschemauri referenced schema document. Note that this means the entity MUST be located within the same Registry.

datacontenttype.description: The content type for the message payload

envelope.description: Message envelope format identifier. OPTIONAL when no owning or referencing Message Group or Endpoint declares an envelope constraint; an unbound Message MAY still declare its own envelope. The available effective definition, after base Message inheritance or cross-reference resolution, MUST satisfy every applicable context: case-insensitive selector equality for a Group, or the Endpoint's envelope constraints with version refinement under the envelope's version rules. Context selectors are not automatically copied into Messages. If the effective definition is unavailable, compatibility is unresolved; this does not require Registry-side acquisition or target existence. The predefined envelope format is 'CloudEvents/1.0'

envelopemetadata.description: CloudEvents attribute declarations, adding constraints to the CloudEvents envelope not yet covered by the CloudEvents spec https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md

specversion.description: CloudEvents specversion declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#specversion. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

id.description: CloudEvents id declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#id. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

type.description: CloudEvents type declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#type. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

source.description: CloudEvents source declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#source-1. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

subject.description: CloudEvents subject declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#subject. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

time.description: CloudEvents time declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#time. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

dataschema.description: CloudEvents dataschema declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#dataschema. The URI of the schema for the event payload. Absence indicates no known schema. This attribute corresponds to the 'dataschemauri' attribute in the message definition and MUST be the same as the 'dataschemauri' attribute of the definition if present. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

datacontenttype.description: CloudEvents datacontenttype declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#datacontenttype. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

mode.description: Whether CloudEvents 'binary' or 'structured' mode will be used

format.description: The media type format used to serialize the CloudEvent in the case of mode=structured

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

user-id.description: AMQP properties.user-id declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

to.description: AMQP properties.to declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

subject.description: AMQP properties.subject declaration. AMQP declarations are OPTIONAL and the common contract does not mark this one as mandatory. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

correlation-id.description: AMQP properties.correlation-id declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

content-type.description: AMQP properties.content-type declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

absolute-expiry-time.description: AMQP properties.absolute-expiry-time declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

creation-time.description: AMQP properties.creation-time declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

group-id.description: AMQP properties.group-id declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

group-sequence.description: AMQP properties.group-sequence declaration. A declared integer 'value' is preserved as a JSON number and is not stringified. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

reply-to-group-id.description: AMQP properties.reply-to-group-id declaration. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

correlation_data.description: MQTT correlation data. This is binary data: its JSON representation is an RFC4648 section 4 base64 string, not a URI template. A declaration written against the earlier uritemplate typing needs the migration described in the MQTT protocol section

user_properties.description: MQTT user properties. This is an ordered array: entry order is preserved and the same 'name' MAY appear more than once. Each entry is an opaque declaration record with an additional REQUIRED 'name' member, defined by the common Property Definitions contract

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

key.description: The Apache Kafka key as a UTF-8 uri template. Mutually exclusive with 'key_base64'

key_base64.description: Binary Apache Kafka key as a base64 encoded string. Mutually exclusive with 'key'

headers.description: The Apache Kafka headers. The whole section is an opaque native-name map: each key is a Kafka header name and is the sole canonical name of that header. Each value is a declaration record defined by the common Property Definitions contract and MUST NOT carry a redundant inner 'name' member

headers.description: The HTTP headers. This is an ordered array: entry order is preserved and the same 'name' MAY appear more than once. Each entry is an opaque declaration record with an additional REQUIRED 'name' member, defined by the common Property Definitions contract

query.description: The HTTP query parameters. This is an opaque native-name map of string keys to string values, not property declaration records. Each key is an HTTP query parameter name, outside the xRegistry map key character set. Keys and values MAY carry RFC6570 Level 1 placeholders

path.description: The HTTP path as a uri template

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

headers.description: The NATS headers. This is an ordered array: entry order is preserved and the same 'name' MAY appear more than once. Each entry is an opaque declaration record with an additional REQUIRED 'name' member, defined by the common Property Definitions contract

epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

envelope.description: Envelope format identifier for common message metadata. If this Group declares an envelope, each available effective Message used in the Group MUST have the same selector, compared case-insensitively. Without an applicable Group or Endpoint envelope constraint, a Message MAY omit its envelope or declare its own. Group selectors are not automatically copied into Messages. The predefined envelope format is CloudEvents/1.0

protocol.description: Protocol identifier that defines the transport message protocol. All definitions in this group share this protocol type. Mixed-protocol groups are not permitted. Predefined protocol formats are 'AMQP/1.0', 'MQTT/3.1.1', 'MQTT/5.0', 'KAFKA', 'HTTP', and 'NATS'

epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

usage.description: Client's expected usage of this endpoint. Single-role declarations are preferred. Mixed declarations are guidance-oriented metadata and should be used only when role semantics are unambiguous.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether the endpoint is deprecated

messagegroups.description: The message groups that are supported by this endpoint. Relative references are XIDs within the same registry. Absolute URIs reference message groups in external registries.

envelope.description: Envelope metadata format identifier. If set, all definitions MUST use this format value

protocol.description: Endpoint protocol identifier. If set, all definitions MUST use this protocol value

endpoints.description: The network addresses that are for communication with the endpoint. The endpoints are ordered by preference, with the first endpoint being the preferred endpoint. Some protocol implementations might not support multiple endpoints, in which case all but the first endpoint might be ignored. Whether the URI just identifies a network host or links directly to a resource managed by the network host is protocol specific

uri.description: AMQP Addressing URI. Authored values MAY carry RFC6570 Level 1 placeholders; the resolved value MUST satisfy the AMQP address requirements

authorization.description: Authorization options. These are hints for the adapter for interacting with the authorization endpoint. This is not a credentials configuration

type.description: The authentication/authorization type. OAuth2, Plain, APIKey, X509Cert, and SASL are well-defined

mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism name when authorization.type is SASL (for example PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512, OAUTHBEARER, or EXTERNAL)

resourceuri.description: The resource uri for which authorization shall be granted (if applicable). Authored values MAY carry RFC6570 Level 1 placeholders; the resolved value MUST be a valid URI

authorityuri.description: The authority uri where authorization shall be requested (if applicable). Authored values MAY carry RFC6570 Level 1 placeholders; the resolved value MUST be a valid URI

deployed.description: If `true`, the endpoint metadata represents a public endpoint that is expected to be available for communication

node.description: The AMQP node name. Commonly the name of a queue or a topic. Corresponds to the 'address' in source or target of the attach frame.

durable.description: Whether the AMQP node identified by 'node' is durable rather than transient. This is a property of the node, not of the link terminus and not of the message header field of the same name. Terminus durability is expressed by 'terminus-durability'

link-properties.description: An optional map of AMQP link properties to use with the endpoint. This is an opaque native-name map: its keys are AMQP symbols and are not constrained by the xRegistry map key character set. See the Protocol Options authoring boundary for the obligations that apply

connection-properties.description: An optional map of AMQP connection properties to use with the endpoint. This is an opaque native-name map: its keys are AMQP symbols and are not constrained by the xRegistry map key character set. See the Protocol Options authoring boundary for the obligations that apply

distribution-mode.description: The AMQP source distribution mode. 'move' means a transferred message is removed from the node and is therefore seen by only one receiver. 'copy' means the message remains at the node after transfer and may also be transferred to other receivers. This does not describe message locking. The enum is advisory at authoring time so that an unresolved placeholder is permitted; the resolved value MUST be one of the listed values

connection-capabilities.description: The AMQP capabilities to use with the endpoint

node-capabilities.description: The AMQP node capabilities to use with the endpoint

source-filters.description: AMQP source filters used for subscription/receive setup. This is an opaque native-name map: its keys are AMQP filter symbols and its values keep their authored JSON kind, including a literal null. See the Protocol Options authoring boundary for the obligations that apply

dynamic.description: Whether a dynamic source or target is requested

terminus-durability.description: Durability mode for the applicable source/target terminus. The enum is advisory at authoring time so that an unresolved placeholder is permitted; the resolved value MUST be one of the listed values

expiry-policy.description: Expiry policy for the applicable source/target terminus. The enum is advisory at authoring time so that an unresolved placeholder is permitted; the resolved value MUST be one of the listed values

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the applicable expiry policy

sender-settle-mode.description: AMQP sender settle mode requested for the link. It constrains the party that sends transfers over the link: the client for a producer endpoint, the remote node for a consumer endpoint. The enum is advisory at authoring time so that an unresolved placeholder is permitted; the resolved value MUST be one of the listed values

receiver-settle-mode.description: AMQP receiver settle mode requested for the link. It constrains the party that receives transfers over the link: the remote node for a producer endpoint, the client for a consumer endpoint. The enum is advisory at authoring time so that an unresolved placeholder is permitted; the resolved value MUST be one of the listed values
